def parse_grammar(rules):
    terminal_rules = collections.defaultdict(set)
    binary_rules = collections.defaultdict(set)

    for rule in rules:
        parts = rule.split(' -> ')
        lhs = parts[0].strip()
        rhs = parts[1].strip()

            terminal_rules[terminal].add(lhs)
        else:
            rhs_parts = rhs.split(' ')
            B, C = rhs_parts[0], rhs_parts[1]
            binary_rules[(B, C)].add(lhs)
    return terminal_rules, binary_rules

    n = len(word)
    cyk_table = [[set() for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]

    # Length 1 substrings (diagonal)
    for i in range(n):
        if word[i] in terminal_rules:
            cyk_table[i][i].update(terminal_rules[word[i]])

    # Length l from 2 to n
    for l in range(2, n + 1):
        # Start index i
        for i in range(n - l + 1):
            # End index j
            j = i + l - 1
            # Split point k
            for k in range(i, j): # k iterates from i to j-1
                for B in cyk_table[i][k]:
                    for C in cyk_table[k + 1][j]:
                        if (B, C) in binary_rules:
                            cyk_table[i][j].update(binary_rules[(B, C)])
    
    return start_symbol in cyk_table[0][n-1]
